title: Missing Method
statement: Implement `solve(implements_send)`. `implements_send` is 1 or 0. Return `ok` when the subclass implements `send` and can be constructed. Return `abstract` when it does not. Do not return a traceback.
constraints: A hole means the class stays abstract
hints: You may also try to construct a real ABC subclass and catch TypeError. The string result is what the judge compares.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Instantiating a class that still has abstract methods raises TypeError.

editorial: Instantiating a class that still has abstract methods raises TypeError. The class object itself can be created. The failure is at construction. That is how you notice a forgotten method before a production call.
reference_solution:
def solve(implements_send):
    return "ok" if implements_send else "abstract"
